claims.statement: The Farrell brothers, sureties on a $3,000 bail bond for Tom Allen's return to stand trial, had their property near Covington, Kentucky, levied on.
claims.excerpt: which they were sureties for the return. of Tom Allen to stand trinl for engaging: in the prize fight with Joe Goss

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought a prize fight with Joe Goss; the date and result are not given in this article.
claims.excerpt: for engaging: in the prize fight with Joe Goss

claims.statement: According to the New York Sun, Tom Allen deserted the young men who had put up his bail and fled to Canada.
claims.excerpt: Allen deserted the young men who risked their little fortune to save him rom afew weeks’ confluement in jail, and fled ro Canuda

fights.excerpt: for engaging: in the prize fight with Joe Goss
fights.notes: Date and result not given; the fight led to the $3,000 bail bond.

notes: Reprinted from the New York Sun; the Sun's account of Allen fleeing is not confirmed here.
